name: Admin Accounting Income Bulk Settle
description: The selection bar shows selected original and pending totals, and Liquidar opens the same IncomeLiquidateModal as the individual action. It lists selected expected company incomes, proposes oldest-first coverage, accepts manual cash allocation and recalculation, and offers a global received amount, destination and Carlos/Gustavo split. A shortfall automatically opens Diferencia for proportional classified deductions and source-linked follow-up expected incomes. Unallocated balances remain pending; zero received is valid with a deduction or follow-up. IVA is configurable per source income with a header switch (off saves 0%), editable rate, before-VAT or included-total capture and base/tax/total breakdown. Unknown VAT remains unknown until edited. Issued accounts, earlier payments or deductions lock rate changes without blocking payment; configurations are saved atomically with settlement and inherited by its children. The form previews POST /api/accounting/incomes/settlement-preview/ before one final POST /api/accounting/incomes/bulk-settle/. Confirmation choices and final review stay inside the same modal. Same-client excess becomes credit; mixed-client credit and invalid distributions are blocked. Preview/server failures preserve the form, and post-commit email failures warn without reversing money. Pocket movements retain their detail with allocation amounts and current balances; income payment links expose the sibling allocations of a shared abono.
